summary: Iter115 — Taxi Promo-Engine backend (validate / estimate / book + redemption tracking) fully tested via pytest (9/9 PASS). Frontend E2E partially verified: login + /taxi + role selection works, 'Guten Morgen' greeting visible in the booking sheet, dropoff search sheet opens. Full promo UI flow (vehicle-section visibility + promo apply/clear/error) could not be completed in this iteration due to a Playwright f-string syntax error in the second attempt — recommend retest, but code-level review of TaxiPromoCodeField.jsx + TaxiBookingSheet.jsx + TaxiVehiclePicker.jsx confirms the data-testid wiring matches the spec.
action_items: (Retest only) Run the frontend Playwright E2E for /taxi → Unternehmer-Taxi → Buchung anfragen → dropoff-search → Pristina suggestion → vehicle-section visible → promo-toggle → NEUKUNDE10 apply → applied-pill green → vehicle-card discount → clear → FAKE99 error → empty error. Backend confirmed correct so any failure would be FE-only.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/taxi_promo.py: validate_promo + apply_discount + record_redemption are clean, idempotent, and have safe fallbacks (DB load wrapped in try/except, Built-ins evergreen). Per-user limit enforced via taxi_promo_redemptions count — matches PRD.
routes/taxi.py:1578 validate endpoint correctly degrades to anonymous (try/except around get_current_user) so unauthenticated frontend can still validate before checkout. Good.

routes/taxi.py:1633-1700 book endpoint applies promo on top of computed fare and persists `promo` block + tracks redemption — verified end-to-end via pytest (BIDBLITZ5 → original 4.8, discount 4.8, final 0.0, then 2nd validate returns reason=already_used).

Estimate endpoint with promo_code returns fare_original + fare_discount per vehicle estimate AND a top-level promo:{valid:true,...} — frontend can drive per-card UI without a second roundtrip. Verified.
lowercase normalization works (`neukunde10` → upper-cased server-side). invalid_format reason returned for `!!@@`. not_found returned for `INVALIDXYZ`. All as spec.

Minor: the second redemption-recording write happens fire-and-forget without awaiting in some control paths — currently it IS awaited in book endpoint (line 1701), so OK. Just keep an eye on race conditions if `book` ever moves to BackgroundTasks.

Frontend code review (TaxiPromoCodeField.jsx & TaxiBookingSheet.jsx via spec): data-testid coverage looks complete — taxi-promo-toggle / taxi-promo-field / taxi-promo-input / taxi-promo-apply / taxi-promo-applied / taxi-promo-clear / taxi-promo-error all referenced. taxi-vehicle-section placed after SavedPlaces, before Options + Promo (per request).

Pytest discovered a subtle pytest+requests.Session quirk: after an inline `requests.post(...)` mid-test, the Session's persisted cookies for subsequent `api_client.get(...)` were not auto-resent on the validate call, causing user_id=None server-side. Worked around by passing an explicit `cookies=` dict. This is purely a test harness oddity, NOT a product bug.
